run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch remained fully blocked by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED) — reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au — despite the proxy status endpoint reporting healthy (bundleCoversEveryHost:true, no recent relay failures), i.e. an organisation-level egress policy rather than a transient fault. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document could be opened; every opportunity is captured at headline level and detail fields are drawn only from WebSearch result titles (which carry the target page's own <title>, e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender', and are treated as reliable for existence/status/ID) and from WebSearch answer snippets (treated as unverified for exact dates/scope). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search. AusTender surfaced four genuinely new, currently-listed Commonwealth ATMs not present in the routine's 473 known dedup keys: EFA2026002 (Export Finance Australia — Reinsurance Brokerage Services), 'NDIA PARG' (National Disability Insurance Agency — Pricing Arrangement Reference Group independent member appointment), ATM_2026_6551 (subscription access to a reconciled dataset/platform+API of Australian utility-scale renewable-energy projects; buying agency not identifiable via search), and 10018162 (Attorney-General's Department — Child Sexual Abuse Recidivism Reduction Pilot Service). Other AusTender ATMs returned by search were already-known (JASD/RFT/20200/1, OPC-2026-02, OPC-2026-03, OET-DRC-2026, RFT_2026_0044, ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM, PR10031930-RASS, RFI_ATM_2026_6026, PRN9254, ATM_2026_3858, DCET-EVCI-CMS-2026, RFT 04-2026 duplicate-of-known) or older/updated pre-Sept items (ATM_2026_2982 shown 'Updated April 2026'). Note: search-answer prose gave internally inconsistent closing dates for EFA2026002 ('5-Jul-2026' vs a 21-Sep-2026 commencement) and 10018162 ('29-May-2026' vs 'contract commences Sept 2026'); because these could not be verified against the detail page (egress-blocked) closing dates are recorded as null. NSW (buy.nsw), VIC (Buying for Victoria), QLD (QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (Tenders SA), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT returned only portal landing pages, aggregator results, or AI-summarised items whose titles/IDs did NOT appear in any search-result link title (e.g. NSW 'Create NSW RFT-2016902', 'SafeWork NSW Body Worn Video', 'M1 Princes Motorway') — these were treated as unverified and NOT captured, per the no-fabrication rule. Tier 2 (VendorPanel councils, GBE utilities Sydney/Melbourne Water, NBN, Australia Post, CSIRO, universities, public health) surfaced no NEW verifiable current opportunity via search. Tier 3 was attempted per mandate (SAP Business Network Discovery / Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities): corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible via search, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. No genuinely NEW buyer-originated source surfaced this run; the only novel domains seen (tastenders.com, qld2032.com, awardedtenders.au, govmarket.com.au, selltostate.com, bidsfactory.com, australiantenders.com.au) are third-party aggregators/scrapers and are excluded per the buyer-originated rule (usable only as discovery signal).
gaps: WebFetch/egress fully blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED) for ALL external hosts this run — confirmed against www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au. No tender detail page or specification document could be opened; all four captured tenders remain at headline level and require an authenticated/unblocked run for deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, exact dates, documents and contacts.
EFA2026002 (Export Finance Australia): closing_date unverifiable — search prose gave a past 5-Jul-2026 close alongside a 21-Sep-2026 commencement; recorded null pending detail-page confirmation.
10018162 (Attorney-General's Department): closing_date unverifiable — search prose gave 29-May-2026 (past) which conflicts with 'Current ATM' status and a Sept-2026 commencement; recorded null.
ATM_2026_6551: buying agency not identifiable from search results (page body egress-blocked); buyer recorded as "" rather than guessed.

State/territory portals (NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, NT, ACT): only landing pages or unverifiable AI-summarised items returned; NSW items surfaced only in answer prose (Create NSW RFT-2016902, SafeWork NSW Body Worn Video, M1 Princes Motorway) could not be confirmed against a buyer-source link title and were deferred, not captured.

Tier 2 (VendorPanel council tenders, GBE utilities, universities, TAFEs, CSIRO, public health): sampled via search only; no NEW verifiable current opportunity surfaced. Full portal sweep deferred pending unblocked WebFetch.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, mining/finance/telco): opportunity detail is registration-/invitation-gated and none publicly visible via search; portals recorded in discovered_sources only, no corporate tender fabricated.
No genuinely new buyer-originated source found this run; novel domains encountered were aggregators/scrapers, excluded by policy.

tenders.title: Subscription access to a reconciled dataset/platform of Australian utility-scale renewable energy projects
tenders.category: Data services / software-as-a-service (renewable energy project data)
tenders.description: The buyer is seeking subscription-based access to a quality-assured, multi-source reconciled dataset of Australian utility-scale renewable energy projects (generation, storage and hybrid), delivered via a web-based platform interface and a RESTful API with supporting spatial and analytical capabilities.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Subscription access to a reconciled, multi-source dataset of Australian utility-scale renewable energy generation, storage and hybrid projects, delivered through a web interface and a RESTful API, enabling non-specialist policy/analytical staff to search, filter, visualise and analyse the data and to integrate it programmatically into the buyer's internal data pipeline, analytical products and BI tools. (Headline-level only — detail page could not be opened due to egress block.)
key_deliverables: Quality-assured, multi-source reconciled project-level dataset (renewable generation, storage, hybrid)
RESTful API for programmatic access and pipeline integration
tenders.scope_of_work: The software must provide current, accurate and reconciled project-level data on Australian utility-scale renewable energy projects drawn from multiple independent upstream sources, accessible to non-specialist policy/analytical staff via web interface and via API for automated integration into the buyer's data pipeline, analytical products and business intelligence tools.
tenders.reasoning: Discovered on AusTender via WebSearch; ATM page title 'Current ATM View - ATM_2026_6551: AusTender' confirms current listing. Scope corroborated by AusTender search snippet describing the reconciled renewable-energy dataset platform+API. Not present in the 473 known dedup keys.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only. Buying agency not identifiable from search results (page body egress-blocked) — buyer left blank rather than guessed. Closing date, value and contact not published in search results.
